summary_for_children: Al-Mursalat means Those Sent Forth. It swears by the winds and shows the earth holding all, firm mountains and sweet water.
environment_concept: Winds in gusts (77:1), the earth that holds (77:25) and mountains with sweet water (77:27).
architecture_and_scenery: Windswept hills, mountains and fresh springs.

activities.name: Wind and water
activities.description: Carry three jars of sweet water down from the spring.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (clay, mountain, spring, wind) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A round stone threshing floor on a bare windy hilltop with a flag on a pole and chaff blowing

primary_mechanic.text: The wind gusts and calms in a changing rhythm, shown by a flag and a meter; toss the grain five times only while the breeze is in the steady band (too calm: the chaff falls back; a gust: the grain blows away too), 77:1-3 by the winds sent forth.

secondary_activities: sent forth one after another (77:1-3, 77:7, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the hill path, the threshing floor, then a reading on the far side
environment_behaviour: the flag droops in calm and streams in gusts
chaff blows off with the wind
the clean heap grows with each toss
unique_world.learning_objective: Know the oath by the winds sent forth (77:1-3)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Winds and the Warnings
story_library.children_narration: The surah begins with powerful images associated with winds and other forces. It repeatedly reminds us of the certainty of the Day of Judgment. The message encourages people to think seriously about creation and accountability.

world_idea.title: The Wind Sculpture Valley
world_idea.description: Explore a kinetic environment with moving grasses, sand patterns, and cloud formations. Activities focus on observation and reflection, not portraying unseen realities.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: Judgment imagery stays unpictured; the winds are nature only.
